parsed.why: Very protective state: statewide gender-identity protections, constitutional amendment, hate-crime coverage, shield law, no facility ban. Parent border/visa, national-facility and custody rules still cap the score.

Statewide gender-identity protections, hate-crime coverage, no facility ban and a court ruling favoring bathroom access. No shield law and sports capitulation, plus the hostile national border regime.
No statewide adult facility or care ban, but gender identity is absent from state nondiscrimination and hate-crime law, with only patchy municipal protections. Parent national restrictions apply.

Most-protective tier: public-accommodations gender-identity coverage, hate-crime law, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, shield laws. National border, facility and custody rules remain the limiting factor.

Hostile state layer: 2025 facility ban, no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime statute, restrictive document rules and worst-law ranking. Parent national border exposure adds further risk.
